Connection, beyond access.

What matters is the connection that follows.

Philosophy

The people behind each work —
across craft, art, and culture — are not simply
makers, but express a way of thinking and living.
SAKAZUKI exists not to present products, but to share the philosophy behind them.
We act as a catalyst — connecting people and culture, and carrying those
connections forward digitally.

JAPANESE

COLLECTION

Artist Collaborations
SAKAZUKI collaborates with artists who embody its philosophy, honoring tradition while evolving craft in contemporary ways, and will
continue releasing annual artist collaboration series with creators who embody the same spirit. The inaugural collaboration features A-Mashiro, a Japanese contemporary artist whose 20-year practice explores balance, emotion, and color. Each artwork becomes a digital Sakazuki — a shared symbol of creativity and connection.

SAKA
ZUKI

The SAKAZUKI Collective
The philosophy comes to life through the SAKAZUKI Collective(NFT) — an invitation-only digital emblem of belonging.
It serves as proof of membership, access to exclusive experiences and artworks, your identity within the community, and a record of your personal journey — uniting tradition and technology in a modern expression of heritage.

COLLE
CTIVE

Creative
Artist

A-MASHIRO

SAKAZUKI
brings
people
together.

A-Mashiro is a Tokyo-based artist who has been creating works for over 20 years.
Born in a traditional Japanese house with over 200 years of history, he grew up immersed in traditional Japanese culture and nature. This rich natural environment profoundly influenced his creativity, an influence strongly evident in his current work.
While he initially worked with oil and acrylic paints, his current practice centers on digital art. His early style was driven by emotion, but he gradually shifted focus to composition and color balance. This shift reflects his view that creation is also a means of maintaining balance between mind and body.
He also has deep connections with generative artists, establishing a unique position among 1/1 artists.

FOUNDER
HIGHBALL
Charlie

FOUNDER

Hi(ball)

“Sakazuki” means “sake cup” in Japan. People used to clink these small cups to show trust, respect, and friendship. This is more than drinking! It’s a simple act that brings people closer and opens the heart.
No other creature shares a cup to connect like this. Only humans do. And that’s why, for me, the Sakazuki is one of the purest symbols of what it means to be human.

Biography

Charlie has been with Suntory for 27 years and is known as the “Father of the Highball,” having sparked Japan’s Highball boom. He developed both the Highball mug and the Highball machine, and is the founder of Good Measure, a Web3 startup within the Suntory Group.

FAMILY

TONY

Immigrant activist turned entrepreneur in the cryptocurrency, blockchain, and NFT space. He is a founding member of prominent DAOs, such as NeonDAO, ReadyPlayerDAO, BrightMomentsDAO, and MeebitsDAO. Tony is an active member of the Web3 community, mentoring and consulting in an effort to support growth in the space.tonyherrera.com

HARRY

Harry has been a project manager in the crypto/NFT space since 2021, working in everything from fine art to pure degen projects. Having lived and worked in Japan and for Japanese companies he also brings a wealth of experience in introducing the hidden gems of Japan to first time and repeat visitors.

STEVE

Stephen McKeon is a managing partner at Collab+Currency, a frontier technology venture fund that has completed over 150 deals across nearly every corner of crypto. They focus primarily on the intersection of AI and decentralized systems. Previously, he was a tenured finance professor at the University of Oregon and co-founded Skyward, a drone software startup.

NEORT

NEORT is supporting the connection between artists who use digital technology and society. In April 2022, NEORT++ an exhibition space specializing in digital art opened in Bakurocho. We aim to create new art experiences between online and offline.
